info.prompt: A cyber-gothic interface where skeletal filigree frames pulse with {neon cyan|electric magenta|amber gold} veins, the board's 60-tile grid fractured into six glowing territories marked by {holographic flags|pulsing sigils}, their Domain connections throbbing like exposed neural pathways when three territories merge, while the Trick Meter's FRENZY tier bathes everything in white-hot particle storms and screen distortion, the whole scene backlit by a void-black abyss with terminal-style hacker text scrolling vertically like a digital exorcism.
